purpose: Requirements for doc-link document search: finding task-relevant documents with high recall, checking ToC rebuild necessity before search, and the information returned in results.
summary: FR-006 search of documents related to a task, prioritizing no omissions over precision
Key handling: --key selects a ToC, omitted key searches the reserved key all in standalone mode
Missing ToC returns a notice that initial build with an index target specification is needed
Pre-search rebuild-necessity check using the stored reinterpretable index target specification
User chooses between rebuilding the ToC before search or searching the existing ToC as is
Confirmation shows counts per change type and the number of documents needing AI summary generation
Undeterminable rebuild necessity stops search as a failure and never offers the stale-ToC option
Searching an existing ToC as is reports possible staleness and does not re-confirm the ToC
Search results include document ID, ToC path, reason, section, and ToC state
AC-019 acceptance criterion for pre-search ToC rebuild confirmation
tasks: Implementing the document search skill or script
Designing search behavior and result format
Implementing pre-search ToC rebuild check and user confirmation
Handling missing ToC or stale ToC during search
Writing tests for search acceptance criteria AC-019
Reviewing search requirements consistency with ToC requirements
